baseline_kernel: Stock SGLang fused eager dual-stream Indexer with unquantized BF16 wq_b and BF16 wk_weights_proj; no replacement is enabled and stock remains the fallback

bottleneck.evidence: This supersedes 20260722b's launch-overhead classification. The immutable Nsight Systems stock capture reports an in-process CUDA-event time of 1.085568 ms, whereas the three unprofiled stock medians are 0.144048, 0.143616, and 0.175168 ms; 6.20x-7.56x profiler perturbation means the captured gaps and idle fraction cannot diagnose the unprofiled bottleneck. Source dependencies and capture-local durations still identify max(wq_b,wk) then max(Q,K), with wq_b+Q the longer branch at 78.368 us and wk+K on the shorter overlap branches. No immutable candidate reaches 1.03x in every repeated fused prepare/store series, so the no-replacement result does not depend on an absolute bottleneck label the profiler cannot prove.

approaches.summary: Compare the CUDA-event time printed inside the corrected Nsys capture with the unprofiled same-campaign stock baselines before interpreting launch gaps.
approaches.why: Nsys inflated the region by more than 6.2x, so its absolute gaps and idle fraction are retained only as instrumented-trace data and the launch-overhead bottleneck label is withdrawn.

approaches.summary: Replace only the BF16 wk_weights_proj call with the direct SM100 CuTe-DSL TGV backend in the corrected BF16-wq fused region.
approaches.why: The immutable paired fused prepare/store results are 0.564382x, 0.562612x, and 0.553539x, while isolated results are 0.329284x, 0.322368x, and 0.361148x; every 60-pair repetition regresses decisively.

approaches.summary: Replace functional linear with direct torch.mm while retaining BF16 wq_b, fixed-model RoPE, streams, outputs, and complete page-64 cache mutation.
approaches.why: Immutable isolated results are 0.984024x, 0.995630x, and 0.996183x; immutable fused prepare/store results are 1.003540x, 1.032630x, and 1.002945x, so only one repetition clears 1.03x.

approaches.summary: Disable only the stock dual-stream branch while retaining the exact ReplicatedLinear and UnquantizedLinearMethod sentinels, kernels, layouts, and output contracts.
approaches.why: Immutable fused prepare/store results are 1.012753x, 0.985414x, and 0.978400x, so no repetition clears 1.03x; the matched capture serializes all four operations on one stream but is too perturbed for its timing to replace the unprofiled result.

approaches.summary: Measure FlashInfer auto, cuBLASLt, cuDNN, CUTLASS, and TGV on the isolated exact BF16 projection.
approaches.why: Every isolated backend is slower at 0.109375x to 0.315262x, so none can plausibly recover its adapter and kernel loss in the target prepare/store subregion.

lesson: Always compare an in-profile CUDA-event measurement with an unprofiled baseline before turning a CUPTI timeline's gaps into a bottleneck claim. A heavily perturbed trace can still establish executable identity, order, streams, and kernel context, while promotion decisions must come from unprofiled interleaved A/B results.
